evidence_boundary: Simulated only. Kinematic point-mass agents, abstract links, literature-derived thresholds, and no hardware.

model_provenance.links: abstract directed links with literature-derived delay and loss thresholds
model_provenance.sensor_noise: isotropic and independent of observer position
model_provenance.separation: Run A ellipsoid separation from sim/interaction.py is used for the separation check
model_provenance.vehicle_fleet: sim/vehicle_fleet.py is not used because it is not wired into the swarm and v1 hardware profiles forbid the interaction hook

summary.traffic_documentation: Counts are per directed route, in messages and bytes. Message sizes are recorded in each kind bucket. In ground mode, believed_alive records the ground station's current plan. After a leaving message is received, an agent stops sending state to that peer.
